name: bamazon
description: Bamazon: an Amazon-like storefront with a cart, checkout, a stock manager and department sales, on Astro and Cloudflare Workers.
author: Paul Xu

scripts.db:reset:local: rm -rf .wrangler/state && CI=1 wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=seed/products.sql
scripts.validate: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run knip && bun run e2e
scripts.preview: astro build && bun run db:reset:preview && wrangler dev -c dist/server/wrangler.json --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 4321
scripts.db:reset:preview: rm -rf dist/server/.wrangler && CI=1 wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local -c dist/server/wrangler.json && wrangler d1 execute DB --local -c dist/server/wrangler.json --file=seed/products.sql
